detail.longDescription:
Book, Track, and Travel Easily with redBus

India’s no.1 app for bus ticket booking with over 18 years of experience and trusted by 5.6 Cr+ users, redBus provides seamless connectivity across 7.3L+ routes with India’s largest bus network of 5,600+ private & RTC bus services. 

Apart from private or STC bus booking, you can also enjoy train reservation, hotel booking, metro tickets, live bus tracking, seat availability, search bus schedule & timetable on the redBus app.

redBus is an official partner of all government bus services, including GSRTC, KSRTC, TSRTC, APSRTC, UPSRTC, RSRTC, BSRTC, NBSTC, KKRTC, SBSTC, OSRTC, PRTC, HRTC, and other state transport corporations.

Travel with leading private bus operators including FlixBus, Zingbus, Chalo Bus, NueGo, IntrCity SmartBus, Fresh Bus, Chartered Bus, Kallada Travels, Orange Travels, SVKDT Travels, Jabbar Travels, Patel Travels, Bedi Travels, Cauvery Travels, KK Travels, UFO Bus, Yolo Bus, Shyamoli Bus, KBS Sree Garuda, Goldline Super Deluxe, Ram Dalal Holidays, Reshma Travels, Deltin Travels, Sri SMS Travels, Varad Lines, Gola Bus Service and more.

Stay connected to your bus journeys with redBus on your Wear OS smartwatch. Track active trips, get real-time updates, & receive haptic alerts - no tiles or complications included.

Get the Best Bus Booking Experience
• Compare bus availability, ratings, prices, photos and reviews before booking
• Choose from Volvo, Sleeper buses, AC buses, Roadways, and Primo buses
• Access exclusive discounts and cashback offers on top-rated buses
• Fast bus reservation and secure online payments
• Easy bus timetable search and live updates

More Than Just Bus Booking
✅ Free Cancellation - Add-on feature that allows you to cancel your bus ticket 6-12 hours before departure to receive a full refund.

✅ Primo - Hand-picked buses with superior punctuality, comfort and service quality.
✅ FlexiTicket - Add-on feature that allows you to change your travel date for free up to 8hrs before departure.

Frequently Asked Questions:
> How can I track my bus on redBus?
Monitor your bus in real time with live bus tracking. View current location, route progress, delays and estimated arrival time.
> What is a FlexiTicket on redBus?
Enjoy free date changes and hassle-free rescheduling up to 8 hours before departure.
> Can I book last-minute bus tickets?
Yes. Book available bus tickets instantly, even at the last minute, on redBus.
